mapper.select:
select s.*, i.thumb_url, i.image_name as image_code from tb_slide s left join tb_image i on s.image_id = i.image_id
AND s.project_id = #{params.projectId}
AND s.create_by = #{params.userId}
AND i.image_name like CONCAT('%',#{params.imageCode},'%')
AND s.remark like CONCAT('%',#{params.remark},'%')
AND s.status = #{params.status}
AND EXISTS(select u.slide_id from tb_slide_attr u where u.slide_id = s.slide_id and u.attr_type = '1' and u.attr_id = #{params.annoUser})
AND EXISTS(select c.slide_id from tb_slide_attr c where c.slide_id = s.slide_id and c.attr_type = '2' and c.attr_id = #{params.annoCategory})
and date_format(s.create_time,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.createTimeParams.beginTime},'%y%m%d')
and date_format(s.create_time,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.createTimeParams.endTime},'%y%m%d')
and date_format(s.update_time,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.updateTimeParams.beginTime},'%y%m%d')
and date_format(s.update_time,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.updateTimeParams.endTime},'%y%m%d')

select m.image_name, m.thumb_url, m.format, m.width, m.height, m.resolution_x, m.resolution_y, m.source_lens, m.image_path, s.slide_id, s.diagnosis, s.ai_analyzed, s.ai_check, case when r.review_count >2 then '2' else '1' end as review_status, r.score, s.image_id, s.group_name, s.gender, s.species, s.product_series, s.dosage, s.animal_source, s.receiving_week, s.dosing_cycle, s.recovery_cycle, s.date_of_death, s.remove_reason, s.remark, s.organ, s.lesion_type1, s.lesion_degree1, s.lesion_type2, s.lesion_degree2, s.process_flag, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.topic_id, s.topic_name, s.status, s.delete_flag, s.organization_id, s.host_id from tb_slide s left join tb_image m on m.image_id = s.image_id left join (select slide_id,count(slide_id) as review_count, group_concat(score separator '-') as score from tb_review t group by t.slide_id) r on s.slide_id = r.slide_id
AND m.image_name like CONCAT('%',#{params.imageCode},'%')
AND s.project_id = #{params.projectId}
AND s.review_round_id = #{params.reviewRoundId}
AND r.score like CONCAT('%',#{params.score},'%')
AND s.remove_reason like CONCAT('%',#{params.removeReason},'%')
AND (r.review_count <3 or r.review_count is null)
AND r.review_count >2
